timeline.quote: Liliana leapt forward, under Belzenlok's arm, and seized the Blackblade's hilt.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Gideon gives Teferi the Gatewatch oath, while Karn and Jaya agree to fight Bolas without taking the oath.
timeline.quote: Gideon was giving Teferi the Gatewatch oath while Chandra stood by.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.

timeline.summary: The planeswalkers leave Dominaria, but Liliana cannot planeswalk and Nicol Bolas appears to claim her.
timeline.quote: Nicol Bolas materialized out of the darkness, his huge scaled dragon form looming over her

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.

timeline.summary: On the new plane Jace tells the others that Liliana never intended to come and used them, but Gideon insists she has changed.
timeline.quote: She used you, just like she uses everyone.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.

timeline.quote: She had left Dominaria, but she hadn't followed him and the others.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.

timeline.quote: "Sea Gate may have fallen, but we still stand.

citation.text: Shoulder to Shoulder (Battlebond, 2018), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Najiya warns Gideon that the plated crusher is not interested in his concept of strength through unity.
timeline.quote: It's not interested in your concept of strength through unity.

citation.text: Plated Crusher (Battlebond, 2018), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

citation.text: "Cult of Rakdos", section "Guilds of Ravnica block". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: During a goblin gang war Krenko kills Dargig and is arrested by Gideon Jura, injuring him with the shiv.
timeline.quote: Krenko killed Dargig, the youngest of the Shattergang Brothers

citation.text: "Krenko", section "In and out of prison". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

citation.text: Duskmantle Operative (War of the Spark, 2019), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Angrath leads ground units against God-Eternal Rhonas while Gideon and Aurelia lead the air, and after Gideon kills Rhonas, Angrath leads a charge that forces Bolas's forces back.

citation.text: "Angrath", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

citation.text: "Aurelia", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gideon stabs Rhonas in the eye with the Blackblade, draining the God-Eternal to dust.
timeline.quote: Gideon stabbed him in the eye with the Blackblade

citation.text: "Blackblade", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

citation.text: "Blackblade", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

citation.text: "Bontu", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

citation.text: "Chandra Nalaar", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gideon sacrifices his life to save Liliana; Chandra believes Liliana killed him and is stopped by Jace.

timeline.quote: Gideon was able to kill the god, stabbing him in the eye with the Blackblade and draining his essence

timeline.summary: Gideon strikes Bolas with the Blackblade, but it breaks against the dragon's flesh.
timeline.quote: He struck Bolas in the head with Blackblade, but the sword broke against the dragon's flesh

timeline.quote: After Gideon killed Rhonas

timeline.quote: Gideon used hieromancy to transfer the contract and its lethal effects upon himself

citation.text: "Liliana Vess", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.quote: Gideon then sacrificed himself to save Liliana from the contract.

citation.text: "Nicol Bolas", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.quote: Liliana interfered, causing the Divine Arrow to miss and impale Gideon's Pegasus instead

timeline.summary: Rakdos attacks Nicol Bolas with Gideon Jura riding him and is knocked from the air.
